title: One stuck queue pick hides every other startable item
what: The lanes line also names the next few startable items after its picks ("next: ..."), a setting lanes_line_items (default 3, bound 0 to 10; 0 is today's line); an item with a "not reproduced" fact note is skipped as a pick.
why: 30 Oct, design "no idle while the owner is away": on 29 Oct night the lanes line named only two-branches-start-on-the-same-file-unnoticed, which the front had found not reproducible, while 19 fixes could start; the front read it as "nothing to take" and a lane stood idle from about 22:22. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: Queue with item X (a "not reproduced" fact note) first and Y second, one free lane: the lanes line names only X.
pass_cases: The same queue: the line names Y
A value out of bounds is noted and the default used
